audit.why: 45.34% over 805 games, HARD 8/10, and all seven rows read Ornn in both phases[N].side and win[N] — identical to the packet chart. Ratings sag to 2/10 at items, which matches a tank who free-upgrades.
All four spikes exist and are placed sensibly. Level 6 as his stage is right: Call of the Forge God is 2500 range, 140s at rank 1, and both the elemental pass and the recast displace.
audit.corrected: No structural change; the level-3 spike's mechanics were wrong and are fixed under point 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page describes his CC combo as 'E-Q brittle-detonate' and calls Bellows Breath a shield. Per Riot's text neither is right: Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9s) leaves a magma pillar, and Searing Charge (E, 450 range, 14s) only knocks up when it COLLIDES WITH TERRAIN — the pillar is the wall he charges into. Brittle comes from the final gout of Bellows Breath and from the R elemental, not from Q.
audit.why: Order matters for survival. The player needs to know the pillar lands first and the knockup only exists if he can reach terrain — stand away from his pillar and from real walls and the knockup simply does not happen. 'E-Q' teaches the reverse order and teaches the wrong dodge.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[0].text, mid, wants.foe[0], report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now state Q pillar first, Searing Charge into terrain for the knockup, and Brittle from Bellows Breath's final gout, with the 9s / 14s / 12s cooldowns.
